svg.aria-label: Relay with dead zone a = 0.3 (M = 1) in a loop with G(s) = 4/(s(s+1)(s+2)). The locus −1/K_N(X) comes in from minus infinity, turns at −πa/2 = −0.47 when X = a√2, and goes back to minus infinity. It meets G(jω) at −2/3 twice: at X = 0.32 (unstable limit cycle) and X = 0.78 (stable limit cycle)
svg.title: Relay with dead zone a = 0.3 (M = 1) in a loop with G(s) = 4/(s(s+1)(s+2)). The locus −1/K_N(X) comes in from minus infinity, turns at −πa/2 = −0.47 when X = a√2, and goes back to minus infinity. It meets G(jω) at −2/3 twice: at X = 0.32 (unstable limit cycle) and X = 0.78 (stable limit cycle)

g.text: The two arms of the locus both lie on the negative real axis; they are drawn slightly apart so both can be seen.
Larger dead zone: a > 4/(3π) = 0.42 keeps the turning point left of −2/3, and no limit cycle is predicted.
